products.name: AlphaSense
products.note: Market intelligence AI; financial research; insider information risk; MNPI controls needed

profile_text.body:
AlphaSense is a market intelligence and search platform founded in 2011 and headquartered in New York, NY. The company describes itself as providing access to company insights, market data, and research across more than 500 million documents, with the stated goal of helping users make faster decisions. Its platform is positioned for professional financial and business research, with clients mentioned on its site including Recurve Capital and Royalty Pharma.

The company's core AI product, also called AlphaSense, is categorized as a Finance and Legal AI tool. The platform incorporates features the company calls Smart Synonyms, Expert Insights, and Deep Research, the last of which the site describes as giving users access to generative AI reasoning models across content sets. AlphaSense describes its outputs as including sentence-level citations and no hallucinations, and notes that its AI models are focused on what it characterizes as high-quality, exclusive content. The site states that AlphaSense received the highest possible score across 14 criteria in an unnamed report, which is quoted as saying the company "has dominated the market with its vision of marrying premier and exclusive content with domain-specific AI for an end-to-end intelligence and decision-support platform."

The held facts note that AlphaSense has a significant presence in New York legal exposure, with 220 associated cases recorded in that jurisdiction, though no specific litigation details are provided in the available data.
